entries.voice_line_en: Dispatch — the garage side door is still locked. Something's slamming it from outside.
entries.subtitle_en: Dispatch — the garage side door is still locked. Something's slamming it from outside.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 調度，車庫側門還是鎖的——外面在撞門。

entries.voice_line_en: Shen Du? If you can hear this… stop following the damn checklist. Open the door.
entries.subtitle_en: Shen Du? If you can hear this… stop following the damn checklist. Open the door.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 沈渡？你要是聽得到……別按表單了。開門。

entries.voice_line_en: …Signal's gone.
entries.subtitle_en: …Signal's gone.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: ……訊號沒了。

entries.voice_line_en: This is the Chenghai Emergency Science Rescue Coordination Channel.
entries.subtitle_en: This is the Chenghai Emergency Science Rescue Coordination Channel.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 這裡是澄海應急科學救援協調頻道。

entries.voice_line_en: Healthy adult survivors, proceed to the marked assembly points and prepare for orderly evacuation.
entries.subtitle_en: Healthy adult survivors, proceed to the marked assembly points and prepare for orderly evacuation.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 健康成年倖存者請前往指示集合點，準備有序離港。

entries.voice_line_en: Bring identification. I repeat: bring identification.
entries.subtitle_en: Bring identification. I repeat: bring identification.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 請攜帶身分證明。重複。

entries.voice_line_en: Don't follow the loudspeaker. The names of people who did are already on the wall.
entries.subtitle_en: Don't follow the loudspeaker. The names of people who did are already on the wall.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 別往喇叭走。去的人，牆上有名。

entries.voice_line_en: If you want the living, follow the gray smoke — not the broadcast.
entries.subtitle_en: If you want the living, follow the gray smoke — not the broadcast.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你要找活人，跟灰煙走——別跟廣播走。

entries.voice_line_en: Badge still on you. City hall man — how many doors did you lock?
entries.subtitle_en: Badge still on you. City hall man — how many doors did you lock?
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 工牌還掛著。市政的人，鎖過多少門？

entries.voice_line_en: Rules here are simple: work first, then eat. We don't eat broadcast rations.
entries.subtitle_en: Rules here are simple: work first, then eat. We don't eat broadcast rations.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 這裡規矩簡單：先幹活，再吃飯。廣播的飯，我們不吃。

entries.voice_line_en: If you're staying, bring the med crate from the alley — or get Old Chen to the white tent. Pick one.
entries.subtitle_en: If you're staying, bring the med crate from the alley — or get Old Chen to the white tent. Pick one.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你要留下，去把巷口那箱藥帶回來——或者把老陳護到白篷點。選一個。

entries.voice_line_en: A fever isn't an empty shell. Don't put a round into someone who can still talk.
entries.subtitle_en: A fever isn't an empty shell. Don't put a round into someone who can still talk.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 發熱不等於空殼。別一槍崩了還能說話的人。

entries.voice_line_en: Deep bites, clean wounds, isolate. If you don't get that, stay off the wounded.
entries.subtitle_en: Deep bites, clean wounds, isolate. If you don't get that, stay off the wounded.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 深咬、清創、隔離。聽不懂就別碰傷員。

entries.voice_line_en: You didn't sell us to the loudspeakers. For now, you're people.
entries.subtitle_en: You didn't sell us to the loudspeakers. For now, you're people.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你沒把我們賣給喇叭。暫且算人。

entries.voice_line_en: Don't let your name end up on that wall.
entries.subtitle_en: Don't let your name end up on that wall.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 牆那邊的名字，別變成你的。

entries.voice_line_en: Script library: calm — assemble — divert. Do not mention sampling.
entries.subtitle_en: Script library: calm — assemble — divert. Do not mention sampling.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 腳本庫：安撫－集合－分流。禁止提及採樣。

entries.voice_line_en: Quota raised. Prioritize individuals marked low pain threshold.
entries.subtitle_en: Quota raised. Prioritize individuals marked low pain threshold.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 配額上調。優先標記「低痛閾」個體。

entries.voice_line_en: I told you. The wall isn't just there to scare you.
entries.subtitle_en: I told you. The wall isn't just there to scare you.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 我說過。牆不是嚇你。

entries.voice_line_en: If you're still walking deeper, decide whether you're bringing back fire — or a fuse.
entries.subtitle_en: If you're still walking deeper, decide whether you're bringing back fire — or a fuse.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你要是還想往裡走，先想清楚你帶回來的是火還是引線。

entries.voice_line_en: Shen Du. You're alive — good.
entries.subtitle_en: Shen Du. You're alive — good.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 沈渡。你還活著——好。

entries.voice_line_en: The garage lock… I signed the remote seal. I thought fewer people would die fighting over supplies.
entries.subtitle_en: The garage lock… I signed the remote seal. I thought fewer people would die fighting over supplies.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 車庫門禁……是我簽的遠端鎖。我以為能少死些搶物資的人。

entries.voice_line_en: The list was altered. Some names got sampling marks. I need the original.
entries.subtitle_en: The list was altered. Some names got sampling marks. I need the original.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 名單被人改過。有些名字後面多了採樣標記。我需要原件。

entries.voice_line_en: (Option A) When you locked that door, someone on the radio was calling my name.
entries.subtitle_en: (Option A) When you locked that door, someone on the radio was calling my name.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: （選項A）你鎖門的時候，對講裡有人在叫我的名字。

entries.voice_line_en: (Option B) The list first. The door… we talk about that if we're still alive.
entries.subtitle_en: (Option B) The list first. The door… we talk about that if we're still alive.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: （選項B）先說名單。門的事……我們活著再說。

entries.voice_line_en: (Option C) I came looking for you — not for excuses.
entries.subtitle_en: (Option C) I came looking for you — not for excuses.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: （選項C）我來是找你，不是來聽解釋。

entries.voice_line_en: Xiao Nan had a fever. She never attacked. Send her to the loudspeakers and I'll pretend I never saved you.
entries.subtitle_en: Xiao Nan had a fever. She never attacked. Send her to the loudspeakers and I'll pretend I never saved you.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 小南發熱過，沒攻人。你要是把她送去喇叭，我就當沒救過你。

entries.voice_line_en: Don't look at me like a specimen.
entries.subtitle_en: Don't look at me like a specimen.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 別用看標本的眼神看我。

entries.voice_line_en: I can run. Don't start a fight over me.
entries.subtitle_en: I can run. Don't start a fight over me.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 我可以跑。你們別為了我打架。

entries.voice_line_en: Toll doesn't take smiles. Batteries, bullets — anything you still need.
entries.subtitle_en: Toll doesn't take smiles. Batteries, bullets — anything you still need.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 過路費不收笑臉。收電池、收子彈，收你還用得上的東西。

entries.voice_line_en: Looking for a ship? That's loudspeaker business. I only sell the road.
entries.subtitle_en: Looking for a ship? That's loudspeaker business. I only sell the road.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你要找船？那是喇叭的生意。我只賣路。

entries.voice_line_en: Leave the goods. You can walk.
entries.subtitle_en: Leave the goods. You can walk.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 貨留下。人可以走。

entries.voice_line_en: Not walking?
entries.subtitle_en: Not walking?
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 不走？

entries.voice_line_en: There's still order here. Come for the grain and I shoot.
entries.subtitle_en: There's still order here. Come for the grain and I shoot.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 這裡還有秩序。你要是來搶糧，我開槍。

entries.voice_line_en: …The attachment? You think I never read it? I did. And a hundred people still sleep at night because of that.
entries.subtitle_en: …The attachment? You think I never read it? I did. And a hundred people still sleep at night because of that.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: ……附件？你以為我沒看過？我看過。我還讓一百人睡得著。

entries.voice_line_en: You go public with it, and tomorrow the warehouse burns before the empty shells even arrive.
entries.subtitle_en: You go public with it, and tomorrow the warehouse burns before the empty shells even arrive.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你公開它，明天倉庫可能先打起來，空殼後到。

entries.voice_line_en: Stabilizer: delays language collapse. Does not reverse empty-shell conversion.
entries.subtitle_en: Stabilizer: delays language collapse. Does not reverse empty-shell conversion.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 穩定劑：推遲語言崩解，不逆轉空殼。

entries.voice_line_en: Controls needed: uninfected baseline / dulled carriers.
entries.subtitle_en: Controls needed: uninfected baseline / dulled carriers.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 對照需求：未感染基線／鈍感攜帶者。

entries.voice_line_en: Broadcast conversion below target. Increase voluntary language in scripts.
entries.subtitle_en: Broadcast conversion below target. Increase voluntary language in scripts.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 廣播轉化率低於預期，提高「自願」話術。

entries.voice_line_en: You think smashing one loudspeaker saves the city?
entries.subtitle_en: You think smashing one loudspeaker saves the city?
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你以為毀一台喇叭，城就會好？

entries.voice_line_en: I'm keeping the books. The next people need a repeatable model. Are you standing on the sample side — or the record side?
entries.subtitle_en: I'm keeping the books. The next people need a repeatable model. Are you standing on the sample side — or the record side?
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 我在記帳。以後的人需要可重複的模型。你站在樣本這一側，還是記錄這一側？

entries.voice_line_en: The ship is real. The seats aren't for everyone. That isn't cruelty. It's arithmetic.
entries.subtitle_en: The ship is real. The seats aren't for everyone. That isn't cruelty. It's arithmetic.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 船是真的。名額不是為所有人準備的。這不是殘忍，是算術。

entries.voice_line_en: His arithmetic turned every form I signed into a blade.
entries.subtitle_en: His arithmetic turned every form I signed into a blade.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 算術把我簽過的單變成刀。

entries.voice_line_en: Shen Du — don't only listen to him. Don't only listen to hate either.
entries.subtitle_en: Shen Du — don't only listen to him. Don't only listen to hate either.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 沈渡，別只聽他。也別只聽恨。

entries.voice_line_en: You can kill a cookfire. You don't get to erase every person with it.
entries.subtitle_en: You can kill a cookfire. You don't get to erase every person with it.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 灶火可以滅，人不能滅完。

entries.voice_line_en: Who you take with you is a sentence on who you leave. Don't pretend you don't see that.
entries.subtitle_en: Who you take with you is a sentence on who you leave. Don't pretend you don't see that.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 你帶誰走，就等於宣判誰留下。別裝看不見。

entries.voice_line_en: Choose. Destroy me — or use me. Don't pretend there's a fourth clean road.
entries.subtitle_en: Choose. Destroy me — or use me. Don't pretend there's a fourth clean road.
entries.subtitle_zh_tw: 選吧。毀我，或用我。別假裝有第四種乾淨的路。
